iterations: Initial duplicated inherited toes and joint/contact failures are retained. Poncho, beard and claw geometry received actual overlap corrections; cap-edge witnesses moved to interior overlap.
Native review exposed obscured eyes, a concealed boot hem, sleeve-shaped bare wrists and overly long Salamanca hair. Source geometry/projection controls correct these defects.

The closer face crop exposed UVs outside their atlas cells. A local data-enabled projection clamp preserves original image pixels and material boundaries; the failed geometry04 diagnostic remains evidence.

Solapa final native review exposed a partly buried hat band and an overhead face camera. The fitted band and lower diagnostic cameras are verified by repeated Solapa continuity; exact-byte reuse bounds the three unchanged species.
Closed intertwined strands replace the plain braid outline, Solapa has a warped straw brim and broader crown, and the hag nose profile no longer obscures the mouth.
reviewed: Final-art front/profile/rear, face/hair/garment details, extreme stride, attack, pain, intermediate death and oblique lying poses; both presentation scenes per species.
qualifications: Stylized closed components, painted face detail, opaque hair and rigid fall/rest poses remain candidates. Fixed clothing does not add modular inventory.

Native scale/collision, stats, combat, loot, identity and saved fields remain authoritative. Reference metre dimensions, powers and campaign placements are not adopted; broad silhouettes can exceed provisional collision.
One sequential700-tic sprite/model pair per species measures queue intervals and simulation spacing, not GPU/display latency, repeatability, an optimization or a campaign/crowd budget.

Coverage reaches43/56 provisional classes;13 remain. Regional displays, other characters/modular fitting, campaign authoring and siege rendering keep the batch unfinished. No author acceptance or final terminal is claimed.
